'''Scott Williams''' is an American voice actor who works on the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
As an adult, Williams became a voice actor. He first worked on {{aniseries|PTS}} during ''[[M10|The Rise of Darkrai]]'', where he voiced {{OBP|Darkrai|M10}}. However, his most prominent roles were during {{aniseries|BW}}, gaining notable roles such as [[Delbert]], {{DL|Forces of nature (anime)|Tornadus}}, and [[Montgomery]]'s {{p|Throh}}. He gained a more notable role during {{aniseries|SM}}, voicing [[Kiawe's grandfather]].
